summary: An efficient atomic layer deposition (ALD) process for preparing MnOx films using bis(N,N′-di-tert-butylacetamidinato)manganese-(II) and H2O as reactants was reported. The process exhibits ideal self-limiting growth behavior with a high growth rate of ~2.1 Å/cycle. The MnOx films can conformally and uniformly grow into deep narrow trenches with high aspect ratios of 10:1, highlighting the application potential of the ALD process in complex 3D or porous structures.
